## Page in progress

We are in the process of adding participants to this page!
:::

Participants with an asterisk (\*) participated remotely, while participants with a caret (\^) were ultimately unable to participate due to travel disruption or other circumstances.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
source(file.path("..", "R", "functions.R"))
```
